title: Essential: Motor output power
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state the mechanical power output of the motor as 32 W.

title: Essential: Stuck thermal power
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state the thermal power of the motor when stuck as 48 W.

title: Important: Circuit current calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Ohm's law for a closed circuit to find the current using the voltmeter reading, EMF, and resistances.

title: Important: Motor power formula
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula for a motor's mechanical output power (electrical input power minus Joule heating in its coil).

title: Important: Stuck circuit analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize that when the motor is stuck, it acts as a pure resistor, and correctly calculate the new total circuit current.

title: Optional: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates consistent use of SI units (Volts, Ohms, Amps, Watts) throughout their calculations.

title: Pitfall: Confusing motor states
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly uses the same current or power formula for both the normal and stuck operating states of the motor.

title: Pitfall: Sign or voltage error
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign error in the loop equation (e.g., E - U) or misinterprets which voltage drop the voltmeter measures.
